intuition: Split the linked list into halves, sort each half, then merge the sorted chains.

brute_force.approach: Copy node values into an array, sort them, and write them back into the list.

optimal.approach: Use top-down merge sort with slow-fast midpoint splitting and an in-place linked-list merge.

edge_cases: An empty or one-node list is already sorted.
Duplicate and negative values retain correct sorted order.
The returned list reuses the original nodes.
